result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning pads, and a traffic signal. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the corners create visibility challenges and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners (lack of daylighting) obstruct the sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs adjacent to the crosswalks on both the left and right sides of the foreground street.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes and parking widths without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting with Flex Posts
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk and install flexible delineators to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust the traffic signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
